sources.title: ALLaM: Large Language Models for Arabic and English
sources.snippet: The ALLaM 7B from scratch model also shows significant improvement over the ALLaM 7B continued pretraining model. Figure 2: Comparison of tokenizer fertility rates. The chart illustrates the fertility rates across four tokenizers: Llama-2, ALLaM Arabic only, ALLaM merged with Llama-2, and ALLaM Arabic/English (from scratch model).
